info.syllabusName: Kết cấu bê tông cốt thép 1 (Reinforced Concrete Design 1)
info.description:
Basic design concepts: Basic layout of concrete structures, loading, basic material properties of concrete and reinforcing steel, limit state design philosophy.

Analysis of structure: Load combinations and loading arrangements.

Design and analysis of flexural members: Singly and doubly reinforced rectangular sections, flanged sections, shear reinforcement, bond and anchorage, serviceability.

Columns: Classification, column behaviour, axially loaded rectangular column, uni-axially bent and bi-axially bent columns, column interaction diagram, unsymmetrically reinforced column.
info.decisionNo: Ban hành theo QĐ CTĐT TDTU

clos.loDetails: This course provides to the students the basic knowledges about the mechanical behaviour of materials in reinforced concrete (RC) structures: concrete and steel.
After this course, students possess theories of calculations of RC elements: compressive/ tensile/ flexural members, shear design, torsion, column.
This course develop the skills of students in analyses and designs of RC elements.
